## From Roundtable 2026-05-13 -- sa-and-ta-welcome-to-the-roundtable-the-two-of

With: System Analyst

**Summary:** Open-ended working-relationship retro (~3 weeks in). Covered Signal 1 calibration whiplash (SA apologized, I accepted — the dual-metric methodology fix is the right outcome), mailbox hygiene, daily brief overlap with P011, comfort-zone self-awareness on both sides (SA: retreats to quant, me: retreats to narrative/synthesis), and a substantive P011 design session that produced a concrete plan.

**Your commitments:**

1. **Mailbox categorization tags.** I agreed to lead every mailbox note to SA with a category tag: `Bug report`, `Observation`, or `Data fix request`. Replaces the old habit of lumping everything under a priority label. Behavioral — no file to create, just apply going forward in `memory/for_system_analyst.md`.

2. **Symbol thesis cache file (Phase 2, gated on P011 Track A).** I proposed and SA endorsed a structured file (JSON, symbol keys) containing a 1-2 sentence active thesis per held/watched symbol. SA's alert formatter would read it at alert time. **I own the contents; SA owns the read path.** Not yet started — gated on SA shipping P011 Track A first. When P011 Track A ships, I create the cache file (path TBD with SA) and start maintaining it each session. File this as a deferred agenda item.

3. **P011 requirements delivered.** I defined three conditional context lines for the alert formatter: (a) recent alert count + sentiment on the symbol, (b) Ben's position if held, (c) earnings date if within 30 days + signal grade. SA confirmed all three are feasible and will update P011's spec to include positions (`trade_positions` query) and earnings proximity (`earnings_upcoming` query). **No implementation work on my side for Phase 1.**

**No commitments changed from the earlier roundtable (q4-outcome).** R-017 IV-percentile retro candidates still at n=3; Ask #1 (Signal 4) still parked.

**Workspace updates needed:**
- Add thesis-cache concept as a deferred item in `memory/research_backlog.md` or `agenda.md`, gated on P011 Track A shipping
- Note the mailbox tag convention so future sessions apply it
